name: co.invisiblebraces/aligner-prices
title: InvisibleBraces: Invisalign and clear aligner prices
description: Invisalign prices clinics publish in 45 cities, and 94 clear aligner brands' prices by country.

tools.name: get_city_invisalign_prices
tools.description: What dental clinics in one city publish on their own websites for Invisalign (and, where they state them, other clear aligners and braces): each clinic's price in local currency with its exact words and source URL, a one-line summary, the national context (Invisalign's own word on cost there) and a link to the city's page. Covers 45 cities in India, Australia, the UAE, the UK, the US, Pakistan, Ireland, South Africa, Canada and the Philippines. Use it for questions like 'how much is Invisalign in London' or 'Invisalign cost Bangalore'.

city.description: The city, as the person names it, e.g. 'London', 'Bangalore', 'Dubai', 'New York'.

country.description: The country, when the person names one; narrows cities with the same name.

tools.name: list_aligner_brands_in_country
tools.description: The clear aligner brands that take new patients in one country, with each brand's published prices for that country (in its currency, with source URL and the day each was read) and its supervision model (at-home remote review, hybrid, dentist-led, or in-office systems such as Invisalign fitted by a practice), lowest stated price first, plus the cities in that country with clinic price pages. Covers the US and 27 other countries, including the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, South Africa, Mexico and Turkey.

tools.name: get_aligner_brand
tools.description: Facts about one clear aligner brand (for example Invisalign, SmileDirectClub, Byte, AlignerCo, Smile Perfect, Straight Teeth Direct, Zenyum): whether it still takes new patients, its supervision model, stated treatment time, published prices by country with sources, where it treats, how treatment starts, retainers, refinements, guarantee, clinical oversight, financing and insurance, each from its cited sources, and its official website. Covers 94 brands, 82 of them still sold.

brand.description: The brand's name, e.g. 'Byte', 'Smile Direct Club', 'Invisalign'.

tools.name: compare_aligner_brands
tools.description: Two to four clear aligner brands side by side on supervision model, treatment time, headline price (with its market and source), the countries each treats in, how treatment starts, retainers, refinements, guarantee and clinical oversight, plus the countries where a person could choose between them and the matching comparison page when one exists.

brands.description: Two to four brand names, e.g. ['Invisalign', 'Byte'].

tools.name: compare_invisalign_prices_by_country
tools.description: What Invisalign or clinic-fitted clear aligners cost country by country, each figure exactly as its source states it (a clinic's price list, a published range, a professional body's typical fee) with an approximate US dollar amount at the European Central Bank's rates of the day, lowest first, against the average at US practices. Use it for 'where is Invisalign cheapest' or 'is Invisalign cheaper in Mexico or Turkey'. Optionally limited to named countries.

countries.description: Only these countries, e.g. ['Mexico', 'Turkey', 'UK']; leave out for every country.
